name: memory-mcp-e2e-testing
details:
Comprehensive end-to-end testing of the memory-mcp server with actual Claude Code instance.

This plan tests all 6 memory commands (view, create, str_replace, insert, delete, rename) plus edge cases, error handling, and security features.

tasks.name: Test view command
tasks.details:
Test viewing directory listings and file contents with various scenarios:
- View root directory
- View non-existent directory
- Create and view a file
- View file with line range
- View file with invalid line range

tasks.name: Test create command
tasks.details:
Test file creation:
- Create simple text file
- Create file in subdirectory (auto-create parent dirs)
- Overwrite existing file
- Create file with special characters in content
- Create file with unicode content

tasks.name: Test str_replace command
tasks.details:
Test string replacement:
- Replace unique string
- Attempt to replace non-unique string (should fail)
- Replace string not found (should fail)
- Replace with multiline strings
- Replace with special characters

tasks.name: Test insert command
tasks.details:
Test line insertion:
- Insert at beginning (line 1)
- Insert in middle
- Insert at end
- Insert at invalid line number (should fail)
- Insert multiline text

tasks.name: Test delete command
tasks.details:
Test deletion:
- Delete a file
- Delete non-existent file (should fail gracefully)
- Delete a directory
- Delete non-empty directory

tasks.name: Test rename command
tasks.details:
Test move/rename:
- Rename a file
- Move file to subdirectory
- Rename directory
- Rename to existing file (should fail)
- Rename non-existent file (should fail)

tasks.name: Test path security
tasks.details:
Test path traversal protection:
- Attempt ../ traversal
- Attempt absolute path outside /memories
- Attempt URL-encoded traversal
- Verify all operations reject invalid paths

tasks.name: Test error handling
tasks.details:
Verify proper error messages for:
- Missing required parameters
- Invalid command
- File not found
- Path validation failures
- Operation-specific errors
